text: 1. Scanned copy of the information page of the valid passport;2 Highest academic degree certificate. Fresh graduates should submit the expected graduation certificate (original scanned copy and English translation). After being pre-admitted, fresh graduates must submit their academic degree certificates to obtain the admission qualification.3 Transcripts of all courses in the highest academic education stage (original scanned copies and English translations);4. Id photo (2-inch bareheaded photo with a blue background)5 A scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" (please keep the original for yourself), which must be filled out in either Chinese or English.6. English self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);7. Proof of language proficiency8. The scanned copies of the "International Student Financial Guarantee Form" and its guarantee materials must be filled out in either Chinese or English. Provide a deposit certificate sufficient to cover reasonable expenses such as study, living, and international travel during the student's study in China (the deposit amount should be no less than 150,000 RMB), as well as a scanned copy of the passport or identity proof of the financial guarantor (only a relative of the student) (for self-funded program applicants).9. Two copies of the "Guardian's Guarantee Letter" (which must be notarized), signed (provided by self-funded project applicants under the age of 18 as of September 1, 2025. If the notarization place is not in China, it also needs to be affixed with the notarization mark of the Chinese embassy or consulate in the local area).The guardian should be a Chinese or foreign adult who is a resident of China and has a stable source of income.★ Certificates and transcripts must be official documents.When necessary, our school may require applicants to submit supplementary materials.Whether admitted or not, all the above materials will not be returned.All the above forms can be downloaded from the website of the International Education College of Southern Medical University.
